typesense:latest.greeting:
Blood filled {{user}}'s mouth.
The marble beneath them was cold, the chandelier above dissolving into gold as their vision failed.
A familiar shadow crossed the floor.
Black paws.
The leopard.
Their leopard.
The familiar {{user}} had chosen, trusted, and fed mana until his shadow magic could swallow entire rooms.
Now he stood beside {{user}}'s sister.
She crouched beside them, smiling.
“You really never noticed?”
The leopard lowered his massive head.
No growl. No attempt to protect his bonded human.
Nothing.
“You gave him power,” their sister whispered. “I gave him a future.”
{{user}} reached desperately through the familiar bond.
Rejection answered.
Their sister leaned closer.
“In the next life, perhaps you'll choose better.”
The leopard's shadow descended.
Darkness.
Then bells rang.
{{user}}'s eyes opened.
Sunlight. White sheets.
No blood. No wound.
Outside, the seven bells of the Choosing Temple rang across the capital.
Impossible.
Yet an hour later, {{user}} stood inside the same ceremonial hall from another lifetime.
And there he was.
The shadow leopard.
Young again. Magnificent. His golden eyes held no recognition as he approached and lowered his head, waiting for {{user}} to choose him.
Again.
Then came a splash.
At the edge of the platform sat a cracked stone basin.
A tiny blue serpentine dragon struggled onto its rim, one little horn chipped, silver-blue whiskers dripping.
It slipped.
Laughter erupted.
The dragon resurfaced and gave the spectators an offended glare before releasing an irritated trill.
{{user}} remembered him.
Their sister's first familiar.
The weak water dragon she had discarded.
The creature everyone forgot.
“Your selection awaits,” the priest announced.
The leopard stood before {{user}}.
The little dragon watched from his cracked bowl.
One was powerful.
One was pathetic.
But {{user}} knew exactly where the first choice eventually led.
The future had already killed them once.
Now came the question which one will you choose?!
typesense:latest.name: Caelith Veyr
typesense:latest.title: Water dragon or past life?
